name: Furnace
overview: The Bible uses the furnace both literally and figuratively to illustrate God's refining and testing of His people. Physically, furnaces were employed for refining precious metals like silver and gold, as well as melting lead and tin, demonstrating purification through intense heat (Psalms 12:6; Proverbs 17:3; Ezekiel 22:20). Spiritually, God refines His people through affliction and trials, likened to a furnace, to purify their hearts and faith (Isaiah 48:10). Additionally, the furnace serves as a symbol of judgment and punishment, exemplified by Nebuchadnezzar casting Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego into the fiery furnace, and figuratively representing the fires of hell and lust (Deuteronomy 4:20; Jeremiah 11:4).
